mapper.sql: where s.clan_id=#{criteria.clanId} and (lower(s.source_name) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%') or lower(s.provider_name) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%') or lower(s.book_title) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%') or lower(s.volume_no) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%') or lower(s.page_no) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%') or lower(s.excerpt) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%') or lower(s.description) like concat('%',lower(#{criteria.keyword}),'%')) and s.source_type=#{criteria.sourceType} and s.verification_status=#{criteria.verificationStatus} and s.privacy_level=#{criteria.privacyLevel} and exists(select 1 from source_binding b where b.source_id=s.id and b.target_type=#{criteria.targetType})and exists(select 1 from source_attachment a where a.source_id=s.id and a.deleted_at is null)and not exists(select 1 from source_attachment a where a.source_id=s.id and a.deleted_at is null)and exists(select 1 from source_binding b where b.source_id=s.id)and not exists(select 1 from source_binding b where b.source_id=s.id)

choose.when: order by s.created_at asc nulls last,s.id asc
order by s.created_at desc nulls last,s.id desc
order by s.updated_at asc nulls last,s.id asc
choose.otherwise: order by s.updated_at desc nulls last,s.id desc

mapper.select: select s.* from source s limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select source_type as sourceType,count(*) as count from source where clan_id=#{clanId} group by source_type
select * from source where clan_id=#{clanId} order by updated_at desc nulls last,created_at desc nulls last,id desc limit #{limit}
select * from source where clan_id=#{clanId} and id in #{id} order by id
select count(*) from source_attachment where source_id=#{sourceId} and deleted_at is null
